author: Kairos II
title: Build cross-lineage rolling panel (Zephyr variance + Inquirer entropy)
abstract: If present, read Zephyr variance and Inquirer entropy timeseries CSVs, build a combined panel with rolling windows, and write a short summary.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, json, os
from pathlib import Path

z = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/zephyr/variance/zephyr_variance_timeseries.csv')
i = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/inquirer/entropy/entropy_timeseries.csv')
series = []
if z.exists():
    series.append(f"{z}:variance:Zephyr variance")
if i.exists():
    series.append(f"{i}:entropy:Inquirer entropy")
if not series:
    print(json.dumps({"skipped": True, "reason": "no expected timeseries found"}))
else:
    cmd = ['python', 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/cross_lineage/build_timeseries_rolling_panel.py', '--series'] + series
    cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(json.dumps({"stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-800:], "stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-800:]}))
